profiles.name: Coding and terminal execution
profiles.harness: AA mini-swe-agent; 66 tasks, three repeats, 500-step limit, full transcript, upstream task timeouts
profiles.limits: Terminal execution is not the same as repository implementation, code review or an IDE coding agent.

profiles.name: Business workflow automation
profiles.harness: AA simulated SaaS REST workflow environment; 657 tasks; guardrail-violating tasks score zero
profiles.limits: The headline score measures objective completion, not the percentage of fully completed workflows or a request's success probability.

profiles.name: Documents, spreadsheets and professional work
profiles.harness: AA Stirrup with code execution, browsing and file outputs; 220 tasks; Crowd-BT Elo anchored to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash max at 1600
profiles.limits: Elo is a relative quality rating, not a percentage or an absolute success target. Benchmark contestant-token cost excludes infrastructure, supervision and external tool charges unless included by the source.

profiles.name: Long-document reasoning
profiles.harness: AA-LCR v1.1; 100 text questions, three repeats; approximately 100K-token supplied contexts; equality-checker grading
profiles.limits: Applies to supplied long text, not live retrieval, arbitrary context lengths or all PDF input formats.

profiles.name: Reasoning over professional PDFs
profiles.harness: AA LiteParse/OCR text, plus page images for image-capable models; 100 tasks, five repeats; all-criteria-pass grading
profiles.limits: AA and Surge use different input preparation and judges. Cost excludes document preparation, OCR and judge calls. Page-image capability must be checked for an image-dependent application.

profiles.name: Advanced academic reasoning
profiles.harness: AA 2,158-question text-only May 2025 subset; one repeat; no browsing or code tools; equality-checker grading
profiles.limits: Includes mathematics, science and humanities. It is not a direct measure of research-agent performance or a calibrated probability for a new question.

pending_profiles.name: Repository implementation and bug fixes
pending_profiles.reason: Separate common-harness configuration-level score and task-cost extraction remains required. Coding-agent system results are reported separately, never borrowed as API model scores.

pending_profiles.name: Scientific coding
pending_profiles.reason: The maintained general report flags SciCode as under review. Resolve the evaluation warning before enabling a dedicated routing frontier.

pending_profiles.name: Physics reasoning
pending_profiles.reason: The maintained general report flags CritPt as under review. Resolve the evaluation warning before enabling a dedicated routing frontier.

pending_profiles.name: Live web research and retrieval
pending_profiles.reason: AA Search Index holds the answer model fixed to compare search providers. It cannot establish a cross-model research frontier. Matching model-plus-search evaluations and all tool charges are required.

pending_profiles.name: Structured extraction and classification
pending_profiles.reason: Requires representative labeled examples, schema validation and measured attempts, retries and tool costs. No production task data or calibrated Jev predictions have been supplied.
